content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect pin assignment for the wl127x interrupt in the device tree source (DTS) file for the Logic PD DM3730 SOM-LV. The interrupt was originally configured to use GPIO 152 (gpio5, interrupt 24), which was not correct. The patch corrected this by changing the interrupt parent to gpio1 and assigning it to GPIO 2 (interrupt 2). Additionally, the patch addressed a conflict with the SMC911x ethernet driver and properly moved the pinmuxes for the related GPIO to the omap3_pmx_wkup, ensuring that the pin configurations were correctly set for the wl127x device.

Code statements:
- interrupt-parent = <&gpio5>;
- interrupts = <24 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH>; /* gpio 152 */
- OMAP3_CORE1_IOPAD(0x2184, PIN_INPUT_PULLUP | MUX_MODE4)	/* mcbsp4_clkx.gpio_152 */
- OMAP3_CORE1_IOPAD(0x2a0c, PIN_OUTPUT | MUX_MODE4)	/* sys_boot1.gpio_3 */
